sourceText:
Original user request: 那你为什么不开始？？？需要我做什么？
Context translation: Start the proposed bounded inventory/topology critic purpose separation now, preserving Harmonynet Git identity and all independent evidence gates, then resume B-7abb and B-03b7 before B-e6d9.
normalizedOutcome: Inventory completeness review launches with actual Git attribution and valid current independent evidence; it grants no topology or lifecycle-completion authority.
acceptanceClaim: A production-path RED becomes GREEN for explicit inventory review without a role-named commit while invalid/replayed/cross-purpose evidence remains rejected and the bounded repair completes local delivery.
